Frequently Asked Questions

ILMUchat is Malaysia’s AI, and as a Yes customer, you now get FREE access to ILMUchat Pro! By combining Malaysia’s homegrown AI with Malaysia’s most advanced 5G network, Yes gives you a smarter way to stay connected, get things done, and explore new possibilities every day. Built with local languages and context in mind, ILMUchat is designed to better understand the way Malaysians live, work, and communicate. Best of all, it is now included with your Yes plan at no extra cost. Powered by Uncapped 5g advanced data & speed, you can turn ideas into action, wherever you are.

ILMUchat is more than just a chat. It is Malaysia’s AI, built to make everyday life a little easier. Whether you need answers to a question, want to create eye-catching visuals, prepare presentations, build digital tools from simple prompts, or simply get things done faster, ILMUchat helps turn ideas into reality. Built to understand local languages and context, ILMUchat supports natural conversations in Bahasa Melayu, English, Chinese, dialects, and Manglish, making it easy to get the help you need, anytime. Created by Malaysians, for Malaysians, ILMUchat is our very own AI that thinks and speaks lokal; celebrating what makes us uniquely Malaysian. From Chat and Design to Present and Build, ILMUchat creates endless possibilities at your fingertips.

This plan gives you uncapped 5G data at full speed, whether you are at home or on the go. No installation, no waiting—just instant access. It includes a free router with a 36-month or 24-month contract, or you can get it for RM299 on a 12-month contract (device RRP: RM1,199).

From 9th October 2025, customers will get to enjoy the new 5G Advanced, delivering faster speed, ultra-low latency, and a smooth, always-connected experience.

7 Days Return Policy is for Yes 5G Wireless Broadband Gateway customers who wish to cancel the contract within seven (7) days from the SIM activation date. *Terms and conditions apply.
